turns.shown:
Rijksmuseum Amsterdam regular opening hours — Not established: no source supported what this rests on.
The Rijksmuseum's own FAQ says it is open every day from 9 am to 5 pm, including all holidays. Only indicated, not established: That covers Monday to Sunday. The shop and The Café stay open until 6 pm (the cited sources do not show: Café, 6). Gallery entry is a separate matter, and the sources disagree on the last-entry time. [10] [6] [8] [11]
Caveat: Only indicated, not established: The Rijksmuseum is open Monday to Sunday from 9:00 to 17:00.

What I couldn't establish
- Official, dated hours from the museum's own website — the search returned only the city tourism listing and third-party sites. None states a date for the hours.
- Last-entry time — I found no official statement of it. Secondary sources give 4:00 pm and 4:30 pm.
- Closures for a specific date — I did not find an official page covering special closures or changes, and the FAQ page has no date for its hours. I did not check the museum's own calendar.

Sources
